title: Istani armor
wikitext:
*Starter armor for Nightfall characters.
*Crafted by [[Mehinu]] in [[Kamadan, Jewel of Istan]], [[Pasu]] in [[Jokanur Diggings (outpost)|Jokanur Diggings]], [[Sulee]] in [[Blacktide Den (outpost)|Blacktide Den]], [[Vatundo]] in [[Consulate Docks (outpost)|Consulate Docks]] and [[Burreh]] in [[Command Post]].
*Paragon and Dervish Istani armor are available as PvP armor.
